property_summary: For any caller and any chain state, after play() with the exact 10-wei ticket price the pot must equal 10 (no win) or 0 (win fully paid out); the mutant leaves 1 wei in the pot after a win, breaking this for inputs whose pseudo-random outcome is 0.
change_summary: Replace `pot = 0;` with `pot = 1;` so after a win one wei remains in the pot instead of zero.
